'''Kalhar''' was a [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Mantellian Savrip]]<ref name="SSW" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was considered a dreaded monster.<ref name="Guide" /> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IV}} on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], which ''[[Super Star Wars]]'' adapts, to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> he spent [[Time/Legends|time]] in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. While he was in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], other patrons steered clear of him until a fight broke out and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] fought with Kalhar,<ref name="Guide" /> using a [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]] to defeat the Mantellian Savrip, who only [[Unarmed combat/Legends|fought]] with his fists and head. Kalhar had [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and gray skin. While at the cantina he wore a brown [[Clothing/Legends|vest]] and open-toed brown [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="SSW" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|One of our favorite aliens came from the scene in ''Star Wars'' where Artoo-Detoo and Chewbacca are playing a holographic chess-like game on the ''Falcon''. Artoo's playing piece was beating Chewbacca's, and we really liked the look of that monster. So we named it Calhar and made it the boss in the cantina level of Super Star Wars. It's like a little trivia game for players; they know they've seen the creature before, but they may not recall from exactly where.|Jon Knoles|<ref name="GM3">{{GalaxyCite|3|Game Room|Game Room: Where Aliens Are Fair Game}}</ref>}}
Kalhar first appeared in the [[1992]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Super Star Wars]]'', in which he served as the "Kalhar Boss Monster" of the game's eighth level. The level can be played as either Chewbacca, the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], or the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]],<ref name="SSW" /> but the [[1993]] ''[[Super Star Wars Official Game Secrets]]'' written by [[Rusel DeMaria]] and [[Wallace Poulter]] suggests Chewbacca be used to fight Kalhar and so this article assumes this option to be correct.<ref name="Guide" />

According to the game's lead animator [[Jon Knoles]], the team working on the game really liked the design of the Mantellian Savrip [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]] piece seen in<ref name="GM3" /> the [[1977]] film<ref name="Year By Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and so decided to include it as a real creature in the game, hoping players would recognize it without knowing exactly where they had seen it before. The character's name was misspelt as "Calhar" in "[[Game Room]]: Where Aliens Are Fair Game," an article written by [[Sue Berkey]] and published in the [[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine 3|third issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine]]''<ref name="GM3" /> in [[April]] [[1995]].<ref name="GM3Date">{{GalaxyCite|2|Rebel Report}}</ref>
